claim: For the right trapezoid \(K=\operatorname{conv}\{(0,0),(2,0),(1,1),(0,1)\}\), the first Minkowski chirality \(\alpha_1(K)\), defined as the infimum over reflection-line directions of the least dilation factor in a translated containment of \(K\) in its reflected copy, equals \(3/\sqrt{5}\). The unique minimizing axis direction is \(\theta=-\tfrac12\arctan(1/2)\pmod{\pi}\).
integrity: The global minimization is established by an analytic support-function and finite-dimensional containment proof.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the specified nondegenerate right trapezoid.
It does not classify all right trapezoids or all convex quadrilaterals.
It does not establish a sharp universal upper bound for planar Minkowski chirality.
title: Exact Minkowski chirality of a right trapezoid
